items.name: figure-example
items.docs: Standalone supplied-data publication example. Uses the same figure props on screen and in explicit 900x600 vector / 1800x1200 pixel exports (6x4 inches at 300 PPI). The theme includes licensed fonts; install IBM Plex Sans in a desktop editor if it cannot use embedded webfonts.

items.name: schema-form
items.docs: Generated schema form for the complete 78-tag instrument inventory. Supply a lazy generated module and native validation callback; canonical JSON is emitted after valid submission. Maps use editable key/value rows internally and emit exact string keys. Basic mode hides defaulted fields. Edited pricing coverage and catalogue activation are separate gates.

items.name: valuation-summary
items.docs: Displays supplied valuation context and raw measures. Comparisons retain independent currencies and stamps; no local differences, aggregates or FX conversion. Pass native metric groups and explicit source-backed units when available.

items.name: measures-grid
items.docs: Displays supplied valuation context and raw measures. Comparisons retain independent currencies and stamps; no local differences, aggregates or FX conversion. Pass native metric groups and explicit source-backed units when available.

items.name: curve-chart
items.docs: Displays validated CurveState entries with point-only stored coordinates. Variants are faceted, same-variant curves overlay. Base-correlation arrays and parametric fields retain their generated schema view. Native figure axes, annotations, typed callbacks, tooltip and per-variant exports are supported; linking requires a caller key mapping. No sampling or pricing engine.

items.name: instrument-form
items.docs: Standalone all-instrument generated form with grouped search, explicit examples and guarded recent selections. Lazy schema modules are reused by native module caching. Native validation is supplied by the consumer.

items.name: pricing-params-form
items.docs: Standalone controlled pricing parameters. Supply native groups from useModels/useMetrics. Every supplied option/history string and omitted versus empty metric selection is preserved. JSON validation checks syntax only; native pricing owns financial validation.

items.name: cashflow-viewer
items.docs: Exact native cashflow JSON through the shared worker with loading, unavailable/error, copy and print states. Requires FinstackQueryProvider. Caller pricing and model state remain intact; no typed rows or totals are inferred.

items.name: monte-carlo-diagnostics
items.docs: Published MonteCarloValuationDetails only: native counts, flags, standard error, full-width bigint seed and time grid. Includes the native LSMC standard-error caveat.

items.name: explanation-trace
items.docs: Optional original valuation explanation rendered losslessly; its published host shape is unknown, so no steps or severity are inferred.

items.name: covenant-report
items.docs: Optional original valuation covenant payload rendered losslessly; no verdict or financial headroom is inferred.

items.name: valuation-details
items.docs: Lazy native result detail routing. Only Monte Carlo has a complete published host shape; composite, credit, FX and structured-credit payloads stay raw. Unknown tags show a warning; full result metadata and nullable fields remain available.

items.name: market-context-form
items.docs: Complete market editor using generated schema/meta and native validation. Edit curves, FX entries, prices, stored surfaces and FX ATM/RR/BF quotes; other data stays read-only and is retained. Import canonical JSON or a calibration envelope final_market. Supply useMarketValidator and receive complete canonical JSON on submit.

items.name: vol-surface-chart
items.docs: Canonical stored volatility heatmap, node table and exact row/column slices. Supply validated surface metadata and an explicit raw-unit color extent. Optional shared selection links caller controls; no interpolation or worker dependency. Import the shared theme. FX quote arrays remain separate from stored grids.

items.name: fx-delta-quotes
items.docs: Raw canonical FX ATM delta-neutral straddle, RR and BF quote arrays. Missing optional arrays remain missing. No forward, interpolation, strike grid or conversion is inferred.
